data.title: A stamp behind the glass

memoryNodes.cue: Maya recognises a bridge on a stamp.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 玛雅认出了邮票上的桥。

memoryNodes.cue: Ellen remembers looking for one missing stamp.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 埃伦想起寻找那枚邮票的经历。

memoryNodes.cue: Maya changes the bridge picture herself.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 玛雅亲手换了一张桥的图片。

data.situation:
At a quarter past three, Ellen waved Maya into the collection corner beside the hall. Her collection of old stamps filled two shallow drawers, though only a few were on display. Maya recognised a bridge on one stamp from a recent walk. Ellen admitted that hunting for it had become an obsession for a while: she had checked the same stall every Saturday until the seller finally found one. Now she preferred explaining what she already had. Beyond the glass case stood two interactive exhibits borrowed from a local museum. Visitors could turn a handle to reveal a different bridge, or slide a map beneath a reading window. Maya tried the handle. Ellen waited for the picture to settle before opening the next drawer. PLEASE LEAVE THE STAMPS BEHIND THE GLASS
Ellen will open the drawers if you would like a closer look. The interactive exhibits are different: turn the handle slowly and slide the map gently. Children are welcome to try them with an adult. Please leave enough room for the next visitor to reach the table.

readingBlocks.zh: 三点一刻，埃伦挥手招呼玛雅来到大厅旁的收藏角。她收藏的旧邮票放满了两个浅抽屉，但只展出了其中几枚。玛雅认出了某枚邮票上的桥，前不久散步时她刚去过。埃伦承认，有一阵子她太着迷于寻找这枚邮票了：她每个星期六都去同一个摊位问，直到摊主终于找到一枚。如今，她更愿意向别人讲讲已经拥有的邮票。玻璃柜后面放着从本地博物馆借来的两件互动展品。参观者可以转动把手，显示另一座桥的图片，也可以把地图滑到观察窗下面。玛雅试着转动把手。埃伦等图片停稳，才打开下一个抽屉。

readingBlocks.en:

readingBlocks.zh:
请把邮票留在玻璃后面
如果想看得更仔细，埃伦会打开抽屉。互动展品则可以操作：请缓缓转动把手，轻轻滑动地图。欢迎儿童在成人陪同下尝试。请留出空间，让下一位参观者也能靠近桌子。

glossary.zh: 收集并保存的一组物件；收藏品
glossary.note: a collection of old stamps 指保存的一组邮票。
glossary.example: Ellen’s collection of old stamps filled two shallow drawers.
glossary.exampleZh: 埃伦收藏的旧邮票放满了两个浅抽屉。

externalEvidence.definition: several things grouped together or considered as a whole

glossary.zh: 使人持续、过度投入的着迷
glossary.note: an obsession说明寻找邮票曾过度占据心思；这是人物回顾一段经历，不是临床诊断。
glossary.example: Hunting for the stamp had become an obsession for a while.
glossary.exampleZh: 有一阵子，寻找那枚邮票让埃伦十分着迷。

externalEvidence.label: Cambridge Dictionary
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: noun [C or U]; everyday extreme interest sense

glossary.zh: 允许参观者操作或回应的展品

glossary.example: Visitors could turn a handle on one of the interactive exhibits.
glossary.exampleZh: 参观者可以转动其中一件互动展品的把手。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Introduce the objects in Ellen’s glass cabinet.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 朋友想知道玻璃柜里是什么，你简单介绍埃伦的物件。
acceptableAnswers: This is Ellen’s collection of old stamps.
checks: 意思与情境相符；允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain why Ellen visited the same stall every week.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 埃伦为什么每周都去同一个摊位？你说说那段经历。
acceptableAnswers: Finding one particular stamp became an obsession for a while.
checks: 意思与情境相符；允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Tell a child which exhibits can be operated and how.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 孩子不确定展品能不能碰，你说明哪些能操作，怎么操作。
acceptableAnswers: You can try the interactive exhibits. Turn the handle slowly or slide the map gently.
checks: 意思与情境相符；允许其他自然说法

transferPrompt.cue: Ask to take a closer look at a friend’s collection.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 朋友带来自己的旧票收藏，你想问能否仔细看看。
acceptableAnswers: May I have a closer look at your collection?
checks: 意思与情境相符；允许其他自然说法
